heading: Reorganize card information to make it easier for delivery drivers to understand.

blocks.html: I regard one package card as the fundamental unit. The primary objective is to display the package information on one single card concisely. Based on insights from our research, I sorted out the key information required at each stage of the delivery process. This help me identify the primary and secondary information for each package card.

blocks.alt: Espoirer — Reorganize card information to make it easier for delivery drivers to understand.
